# Meta Quest Touch Plus controller assets

Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. All rights reserved.

Extracted without mesh changes from Meta XR Core SDK 207.0.1, downloaded from the official registry:
https://npm.developer.oculus.com/com.meta.xr.sdk.core/-/com.meta.xr.sdk.core-207.0.1.tgz

Models, textures and animation controllers are used in this Quest application under the accompanying license.

The OpenXR grip-to-model transform follows OVRInput.cs, _gripToVrapiOffsetInverse, in the same SDK: inverse(TRS((0,-0.03,-0.04), quaternion(-0.5,0,0,0.86603), unit scale)).

Documentation: https://developers.meta.com/vr/documentation/unity/controller-animations/
